lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Skill consolidation: congruence defined by rigid motion

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In two triangles, all three pairs of corresponding sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 27° and ∠B = 24°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they can be scaled to match

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 61° and ∠B = 37°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves area but may change side lengths
preserves shape but may change size

items.prompt: In two triangles, the hypotenuses and one pair of legs of two right triangles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding sides and the pair of included angles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 66° and ∠B = 77°. Find ∠F.
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: only the corresponding angles are congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent
the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent
